# Frontend (React)

The React application will deliver the modern UI for GenApp. Start with a customer inquiry dashboard, then expand to full policy management.

## Planned Stack
- Vite + React + TypeScript
- React Router, React Query (server state), React Hook Form
- Component library: start with Tailwind CSS or Chakra UI for fast scaffolding
- Testing: Vitest + Testing Library, Cypress for end-to-end

## Directory Layout (to be generated by Vite)
```
src/
  api/           # axios client, query hooks
  components/    # shared UI components (headers, tables, forms)
  features/
    customers/   # pages, forms, state for customer flows
  providers/     # QueryClient, theming, routing
```

## Immediate Tasks
1. Scaffold the app: `npm create vite@latest frontend -- --template react-ts` (run from repo root, or adjust path).
2. Configure environment variables (`VITE_API_BASE_URL`) to align with Docker compose.
3. Build the customer inquiry view that mirrors SSC1 fields using mock data; swap to live API once backend is ready.
4. Add Cypress test covering the inquiry flow and connect it to GitHub Actions.

## Docker
A placeholder Dockerfile is included. Update it after initializing the Vite project to copy `package.json`, install dependencies, and run `npm run build` for production images. For local development you can still run `npm run dev` outside Docker when convenient.
